mentions.name: ScaleDown Prompt Extension
mentions.description: A free browser extension for writing better AI prompts. It offers prompt templates, prompt saving, and prompt optimization to improve performance, with no login or payment required.
mentions.problem: The builder realized many people, including themselves, are poor prompt writers and need help crafting effective prompts.
mentions.source_excerpt: So i created this extension to help me write better prompts, using templates, save prompts, and optimize it for better performance. No login, not paid, just a useful little extension.
